mapper.select: SELECT id, session_type, post_id, order_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM chat_session WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (session_type, post_id, order_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sessionType}, #{postId}, #{orderId}, #{lastMessageId}, #{lastMessageTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET session_type = #{sessionType}, post_id = #{postId}, order_id = #{orderId}, last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, last_message_time = #{lastMessageTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
